response.name: Nolla A-Frames Near Yosemite
response.overview:
Off-Grid A-Frame Glamping Near Yosemite 🌄🛖

Tucked just 15 miles east of Groveland and about 20 minutes from the Yosemite National Park entrance, our modern A-frame cabins offer a unique, off-grid experience for those who want a little more comfort than a tent - without giving up the adventure.

Designed by the Finnish group Nolla, these minimalist and cozy cabins are built to help you unplug and unwind. Each cabin is well insulated, includes fresh linens, and Rumpl blankets to keep you warm.

Perfect for couples, small families, or close-knit friends, the cabin can be arranged as either two twin beds or a king-sized bed to accommodate up to four people. Whether you’re here for a romantic getaway under the stars or a no-frills glamping basecamp for Yosemite exploration, these cabins offer a mix of simplicity and comfort.

Each A-frame is equipped with solar power for small device charging, a portable fan, and access to an odorless composting toilet (cabin 2,3) or a pottery (cabin 1) near the cabin. The cabins also have access to hot showers and flushing toilets across the highway at our sister property. It’s a true step off the beaten path and into a more immersive experience.

The cabins include a bed, shelter from the elements, and solar-powered lighting and charging. Because this is a rustic glamping experience, the cabin doors do not lock. We are located in a quiet, remote setting, and guests should plan accordingly. 

 • Cabin 1: Easily accessible for most vehicles. 

 • Cabins 2 and 3: A bit more adventurous - AWD or 4x4 recommended during rain or wet conditions.

Note that when temperatures in Groveland are above 90 degrees, the cabins do get quite warm. The best ways we have found to manage the heat is by leaving the doors open during the day (with the screen door closed), curtain closed, and fan on all day. 

If you're looking for a cozy basecamp that combines the comfort of a cabin with the spirit of camping, you'll feel right at home here.

review_summaries.summary: This campsite offers a cozy and convenient base for exploring Yosemite National Park. Guests frequently mention the stunning views, from sunrises to starry nights, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere. The cabins are praised for their cleanliness and comfort, though some visitors noted minor issues like cobwebs or ants. Access to clean showers and proximity to the park entrance are appreciated, making it a practical choice for nature lovers.

The campsite offers a clean and well-maintained bathroom experience, which many guests appreciated after a long day exploring Yosemite. While most found the facilities to be spotless, a few guests noted the presence of cobwebs, which could be improved. The showers, available at a nearby sister property, were highlighted as a convenient perk, providing a refreshing end to the day. Overall, the bathroom facilities were a hit for those seeking comfort in nature.

The campsite warmly welcomes pets, making it a perfect getaway for travelers who want to bring their furry companions along. Reviews indicate that pet owners had a delightful experience, with plenty of space for dogs to roam. While some pets might get a bit dusty from the red clay, the overall stay remains enjoyable. The hosts ensure that pet-friendly accommodations are comfortable for both pets and their humans.

The campsite provides a sense of seclusion and privacy, ideal for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle. Many guests appreciated the quiet and peaceful environment, which allowed for a relaxing retreat. While some cabins are near each other, they are positioned to maintain privacy, creating a serene atmosphere. Overall, the campsite offers a tranquil getaway surrounded by nature's beauty.

The hosts, Liza and Tom, are consistently praised for their hospitality and attentiveness. Guests found them to be responsive and accommodating, enhancing the overall experience. Their efforts to provide clear directions and helpful tips were particularly appreciated. The personalized service from the hosts contributes to a welcoming and enjoyable stay.

Nestled close to Yosemite, the campsite offers easy access to the park's wonders. Guests highlighted the proximity to Yosemite's entrance, making it an excellent base for day trips. The surroundings provide stunning views that enhance the camping experience. With nearby amenities and nature spots, the location is both practical and picturesque.

Families found the campsite to be a delightful retreat, catering well to both adults and kids. The cabins provide a cozy and comfortable environment, making it ideal for family bonding. The serene surroundings and engaging nature experiences create lasting memories for all ages. The site is well-suited for family outings, offering both adventure and relaxation.

sites.name: Cabin 1
sites.overview: Cabin 1 is our most accessible site, while still offering plenty of privacy and quiet. It is a short drive to this site, and offers beautiful views, a picnic table, and a composting toilet. This Nolla Cabin has 2 Twin beds, or you can convert them into a King sized bed by adding our provided planks in between. Perfect for a couple, two friends, or a family of 4 (with young kids). The cabin includes a solar battery (enough to charge your devices and more). We will provide bedding: sheets, pillows, and cozy Rumpl blankets.

sites.name: Cabin 2
sites.overview: Cabin 2 is located near Cabin 3. While still offering privacy from one another, separated by trees, these Nolla Cabins are also a good option if traveling with a group. Cabin 2 is farther back on the property, tucked away near a stream. You will truly feel like you are in the wilderness here. There is a picnic table and Yeti cooler provided, as well as a composting toilet, shared by Cabin 3. During the rainy season, All Wheel or 4 Wheel Drive is required to access this cabin. The cabin includes a solar battery (enough to charge your devices and more). We will provide bedding: sheets, pillows, and cozy Rumple blankets.

reviews.text: Lovely spot in a quiet neighborhood within a hourish drive to Yosemite
The site was lovely, and the hosts were very kind. I would recommend this to anyone. Very great location too, about an hour out from the park.
Wonderful hosts! Great little camping place and very affordable!

I’m always hesitant to rave about someplace I’ve stayed for fear more campers will come and it will no longer be available to book in the future.  However, Meadow View Haven was an absolutely beautiful location with all the amenities needed for me to stay while visiting family in the area.  The host(s) were very responsive to any questions I had.  I would highly recommend staying here.  Just one note: bring extra sewer lines as the sewer port was far away after finding the most level spot.
reviews.title: Beautiful location

reviews.text: Directions were clear. Good place to Camp of you are planning to visit Yosemite
reviews.title: Flexible check in time

reviews.text: Easy place to car camp before heading to Yosemite. Didn’t meet the host because we arrived late and left early but was easy to find and set up for the night. Would stay again
We had a very pleasant stay. The hosts were kind, helpful, and easy to communicate with. Everything went smoothly, and we appreciated having a great and peaceful spot for our RV. Thank you.
reviews.title: Pleasant stay with helpful hosts

reviews.text: Our hosts were wonderful and the site was perfect. Thank you so much!

I loved camping on Kiya’s land! I know a lot of people talked about using this spot as a prep/debrief launch pad before or after their trip to Yosemite, but I used it as my base camp. 

It was so nice to have a quiet space all to myself away from the insane crowds and packed campgrounds in the park. 

The drive in was an hour to the entrances, but that gave me time to reflect on my trip, get psyched with a playlist, and have my breakfast! Seeing the sun set on the way out of the park was so beautiful every day, and it was so peaceful. For context, I wanna mention that I love driving. 

About their site: I definitely overpacked, because they have water access and a power outlet to charge your devices/lights etc. There is also an outdoor makeshift bathroom for you to use which was a really considerate touch! The solar panels nearby are perfect to put things you want to keep dry under, but be mindful of the separations between panels, as rain may sprinkle down in between them. 

I felt very welcome there, they came out to check on me the first night I was there, and even gave me some recommendations on where to go in the park, and even was left a friendly note giving me a head’s up about some rain on the way so my gear wouldn’t get soaked! Very gracious, warm, and considerate. 

I would absolutely come back again, I want more time to check out not only the park but also what Mariposa has to offer. 

A perfect spot for both a couple days or spending the night when passing through
reviews.title: Yosemite Adjacent Oasis

reviews.text: Extremely sweet and accommodating hosts. Easy directions/instructions for staying at their site which is in such a quiet, gorgeous area. The animals on property were also amazing. Would definitely recommend staying here and hope to stay again in the future if we're ever in the area.
reviews.title: Perfect,little spot with great host

reviews.text: The hosts were fantastic and had wonderful hospitality. They responded quickly every time I had a question.

My second time staying here in a week. It's a great spot to get things done before going into Yosemite and out of Yosemite which I did both times. I couldn't go in at the closest entrance from this hip camp because the HWY was closed due to a rock slide, but going through the South entrance instead was fine. The host is super responsive and nice.

This is a great spot with FULL hookup in Mariposa. I love staying at places with all the amenities so I can do a full reset of the van before I head into a national park. Host was super helpful and accommodating. I'm staying again when I leave Yosemite.
reviews.title: Great spot near Yosemite
